title: Rapid Identification of Moving Contaminant Sources Through Physics-Based Modelling
summary: In an act of sabotage or terrorism, hazardous material might be released deliberately into the atmosphere to threaten individuals, e.g., those operating critical infrastructure. Hazardous materials in such a scenario include toxic industrial chemicals (TICs), which are often invisible to the human eye, making it difficult to detect and respond to releases in a timely manner.
